dramaticChangeTrait.title: ~ Change Trait ~
dramaticChangeTrait.infoHTML: Choose a different trait for the current round of the Dramatic Task. As long as you haven't rolled yet this round, you can change your choice as often as you like.
dramaticChangeTrait.noteHTML: NOTE:  Please confirm with the GM that the chosen trait is appropriate for the task at hand. In the next round, your latest choice will be the default — you can change it again then.
dramaticChangeTrait.noLongerPossible: No longer possible — you've already acted this round.

dramaticSupport.title: ~ Support a Roll ~
dramaticSupport.bonusInfoHTML: A successful Support grants the target in the current round a +1 bonus (+2 with a raise) on their roll. Only actors who have not yet rolled this round can be supported.
dramaticSupport.warningHTML: NOTE:  Coordinate with the GM whether the trait you selected here is actually suitable to support the other actor's roll.

dramaticSupport.noLongerPossible: Support no longer possible — the target has acted in the meantime.

dramaticSupport.helperLineTooLate: Support no longer possible — target has already acted
dramaticSupport.helperLineCapExceeded: Support not possible — limit of +4 already reached

chatDesign.name: Chat design
chatDesign.hint: Choose the style in which dice results are displayed in the chat.

enableHiddenRolls.name: Buttons "Hidden Rolls"
enableHiddenRolls.hint: Adds buttons for 'Private GM Roll', 'Blind GM Roll', and 'Private Roll'.

explodingMode.name: Button "Exploding Dice"
explodingMode.hint: Activates or deactivates a button that, when selected, applies the exploding dice mechanic (dice that show the highest possible value are rolled again and the results are added).

explodingDefault.name: "Exploding Dice" always active
explodingDefault.hint: The "Exploding Dice" toggle is enabled by default.

enableWildDie.name: "Wild Die" button
enableWildDie.hint: Adds a button for the 'Savage Worlds' Wildcard die. It can always explode, regardless of the "Exploding Dice" toggle.

enableModifiers.name: Button "Modifiers"
enableModifiers.hint: Allows adding dice modifiers. Multiple values can be combined.

enableFirstColumn.name: Extra column for "1" die
enableFirstColumn.hint: NOTE: The die icons are clickable and roll one die each.

closeFormOnRoll.name: Window closes automatically
closeFormOnRoll.hint: If enabled, the dice window closes after each roll.

maxDiceCount.name: Maximum number of dice:
maxDiceCount.hint: Number of dice that can be rolled simultaneously.

enableD2Rolls.name: Enable "d2" rolls
enableD2Rolls.hint: Makes the row with the 'D2' dice visible.

enableD100Rolls.name: Enable "d100" rolls
enableD100Rolls.hint: Makes the row with the 'D100' dice visible.

enableFateRollButton.name: Button "Fate Roll"
enableFateRollButton.hint: Randomly selects one token from the currently selected tokens and posts the name to chat.

enableGroupSelection.name: Show candidates?
enableGroupSelection.hint: Shows or hides which tokens were in the selection pool.

groupSelectionYes.name: yes
groupSelectionYes.hint: All candidate token names will be shown in chat.

groupSelectionNo.name: no
groupSelectionNo.hint: Only the selected token's name will be shown in chat.

highlightNaturalOnes.name: Enable Critical Failure mechanic
highlightNaturalOnes.hint: If enabled, the Savage Worlds rule for 'critical failures' also applies to 'Free Rolls' and not only to requested rolls. The rule: If a die shows a natural one, the final result is highlighted in red, even if it was later modified by modifiers. With multiple dice, this only applies if more than half of all dice (including a possible Wild Die) show a natural one. For a Wild Card, a 'Critical Failure' only occurs if the Wild Die also shows a natural one.

enableRequestRoll.name: Enable Roll Requests
enableRequestRoll.hint: The GM can request single checks, group checks, opposed checks and dramatic task checks from players.
